scenarios.label: Optimistic (+20%)
scenarios.description: Stronger than expected customer adoption and above-average trading volumes.

scenarios.label: Expected (Baseline)
scenarios.description: Base business operations meeting planned revenue targets.

scenarios.label: Conservative (-20%)
scenarios.description: Subdued initial demand, local seasonal slump, or delayed customer traction.

scenarios.label: Severe (-40%)
scenarios.description: Prolonged adverse shock, aggressive new competitor entry, or economic headwinds.

verdictThresholds.label: Comfortable
verdictThresholds.description: Repayment obligations consume less than 30% of monthly income, leaving ample buffer for operating expenses and savings.

verdictThresholds.label: Manageable
verdictThresholds.description: Repayment consumes 30%–40% of income. Obligations are manageable with prudent monthly cash-flow discipline.

verdictThresholds.label: Tight — Build Buffer
verdictThresholds.description: Repayment consumes 40%–50% of income. Financial cushion is slim; consider maintaining an emergency cash buffer.

verdictThresholds.label: High Risk — Reconsider Structure
verdictThresholds.description: Repayment consumes 50%+ of income. Severe vulnerability to default under revenue shortfalls; restructuring recommended.

recommendations.tightScenario: Consider keeping a larger operating liquidity buffer (at least 3 months of EMI) or reducing the initial borrowing requirement.
recommendations.severeHighRisk: Your repayment burden becomes high under a severe income decline. Consider reducing the loan amount, increasing your own contribution, or securing a longer repayment tenure.
recommendations.comfortable: Repayment burden remains within comfortable limits across tested operating scenarios.

disclaimers.mathematicalSimulation: Stress scenarios are illustrative mathematical simulations based on the income figure provided. They do not guarantee actual business revenue or loan repayment outcomes.
disclaimers.incomeLimitation: Stress testing uses the income figure provided and does not account for unreported operating expenses or household overheads.
